mentions.name: Cigaal
mentions.description: A super-ecosystem app for underrepresented regions that blends social media, commerce, payments, and crypto rewards, positioned as a lightweight alternative to WeChat, Grab, and Temu. Features include a marketplace with delivery and travel booking, an in-app crypto rewards system (ZooCoin), AR shopping with short videos, stories, and chat, a unified profile and wallet (Cigaal ID), an agent economy where agents handle cash deposits, deliveries, and business API integrations, and CoreIQ, an AI memory core that assists users across all Cigaal mini-apps such as wallet, health, travel, and shopping.
mentions.problem: Places with limited infrastructure lack modern digital experiences, and users risk being locked into Big Tech platforms.
mentions.audience: Creators, travelers, small businesses, and buyers in underrepresented regions with limited digital infrastructure.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building Cigaal, a super-ecosystem app that blends social media, commerce, payments, crypto rewards, and AI. Think of it as a lightweight alternative to WeChat, Grab, and Temu – but designed for underrepresented regions first.
